chapters.title: Welcome to Unreal Engine 🚀
chapters.description: Get ready for the ultimate game development journey! Learn what Unreal Engine is, install it, and start your first project.

chapters.title: Editor Deep Dive 🔍
chapters.description: Master the Unreal Editor: viewport controls, panels, content browser, and more.

chapters.title: Actors & Level Design 🏗️
chapters.description: Understand actors, placements, transformations, and build your first beautiful level.

chapters.title: Blueprints – Visual Scripting 🧩
chapters.description: Unleash the power of Blueprints: events, variables, and logic without writing code.

chapters.title: Materials & Textures 🎨
chapters.description: Create stunning visuals with the Material Editor, master textures, and apply realistic surfaces.

chapters.title: Lighting & Post-Processing 💡
chapters.description: Illuminate your worlds with dynamic and static lighting, then polish with post‑process effects.

chapters.title: Physics & Collisions ⚙️
chapters.description: Make objects interact realistically: physics simulation, collision presets, triggers, and ragdolls.

chapters.title: User Interfaces (UMG) 🖥️
chapters.description: Design heads‑up displays, menus, and interactive widgets with Unreal Motion Graphics.

chapters.title: Audio & Visual Effects 🔊
chapters.description: Bring your game to life with sound cues, ambient audio, and particle effects like Niagara.

chapters.title: Packaging & Deployment 📦
chapters.description: Build your project for Windows, Mac, mobile, and console, plus essential optimization tips.

chapters.title: Advanced Blueprints 🧠
chapters.description: Level up with functions, macros, event dispatchers, and interfaces for cleaner logic.

chapters.title: Intro to C++ in Unreal 💻
chapters.description: Explore the power of C++: create classes, expose to Blueprints, and compile your first module.

chapters.title: Capstone Projects 🏆
chapters.description: Apply everything you’ve learned by building complete mini‑games and interactive experiences.
